name: reefer-ready-pms
description: ReeferReady PMS — container readiness pipeline, built on the Crystal Design System.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run tokens && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run tokens && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @pms/api" "npm run dev -w @pms/web"
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run build -w @pms/shared && npm run build -w @pms/api && npm run build -w @pms/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pms/shared && npm run test -w @pms/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run test
